title: The Life of Jesus — Stories from the Gospels Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of the life of Jesus!

questions.question: Where was Jesus born?
questions.explanation: Jesus was born in Bethlehem, in a stable because there was no room at the inn (Luke 2:4-7).

questions.question: Where did Mary and Joseph find 12-year-old Jesus?
questions.explanation: Mary and Joseph found Jesus in the Temple, talking with the teachers about God (Luke 2:46).

questions.question: How many disciples did Jesus choose?
questions.explanation: Jesus chose 12 special helpers called disciples to follow Him and learn from Him.

questions.question: In the miracle of the feeding of the 5,000, what food did the boy have?
questions.explanation: A young boy had 5 loaves of bread and 2 fish, which Jesus used to feed 5,000 people (John 6:9).

questions.question: In the parable of the Good Samaritan, who helped the hurt man?
questions.explanation: The Samaritan stopped to help the hurt man, showing that we should love and help everyone (Luke 10:33-34).

questions.question: What did the angel say at the empty tomb?
options: He is not here; He has risen
questions.explanation: The angel told the women, 'He is not here; He has risen, just as He said' (Matthew 28:6).

questions.question: What were Peter and Andrew doing when Jesus called them?
questions.explanation: Peter and Andrew were fishermen casting their nets when Jesus said, 'Follow me' (Matthew 4:18-19).

questions.question: Why did Jesus perform miracles?
options: To show He is the Son of God
questions.explanation: Jesus performed miracles to show people that He is the Son of God and that He loves and cares for them.
